verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents custom note templates or saved prompts per meeting type. Fellow's documented AI notes produce a standard summary, action items, decisions and topic-based minutes for every meeting. The API agenda-write endpoints and the suggestion to pass transcripts to an LLM for tailored recaps are developer building blocks or user-side workarounds, not the product's own per-meeting-type template capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format
